# github_enterprise_scim_user (Data Source)

Reads existing Enterprise Managed Users SCIM identities. Read-only: it never provisions users or groups and never manages membership; the IdP remains the only SCIM writer.

## Example

```hcl
data "github_enterprise_scim_user" "example" {
  provider = github-enterprise

  scim_user_id = "example-user-id"
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Requirement | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | `Bool` | Read-only | SCIM active flag. An explicit false is preserved; go-github types this as a plain bool, so an omitted flag also reads as false. |
| `display_name` | `String` | Read-only | SCIM displayName, or null when omitted. |
| `enterprise_slug` | `String` | Optional | Enterprise account slug. Defaults to the provider-level enterprise_slug. |
| `external_id` | `String` | Read-only | IdP externalId, or null when omitted. |
| `id` | `String` | Read-only | enterprise_slug:raw SCIM user ID. |
| `scim_user_id` | `String` | Required | Opaque, case-sensitive SCIM user ID from GitHub. |
| `user_name` | `String` | Read-only | SCIM userName, which is not necessarily the normalized GitHub login; null when omitted. |

See the [provider guide](https://github.com/vmvarela/terraform-provider-github-enterprise#authentication) for authentication, ownership and compatibility requirements.
